title: Prompt libraries: storing, versioning, and sharing your best prompts
body:
Once you've crafted a prompt that reliably produces great results for a recurring task, it's worth saving it rather than reinventing it each time. Good practice for a prompt library:

  • Organize by task type (writing, coding, analysis, customer communication).
  • Version your prompts as you improve them.
  • Note the context each prompt was designed for.
  • Share within a team so good prompting techniques compound across multiple people.

This habit turns one-off prompting wins into a reusable, growing asset.
